integrity: Exact symbolic geometry plus standard-library finite-field checker; geometric completeness supplied by an independent blowup and adjunction argument, not enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Specific coefficientwise characteristic-five singular Clebsch specialization; no classification of arbitrary nodal cubic surfaces; priority provisional owing to inaccessible/unindexed older tables.
title: The characteristic-five Clebsch specialization has twenty-one split lines and an exceptional six-point action
